g.text: Hey. Quincy. I'm sorry. I lost my temper.
so u got a home or what? ur crashing here like ur my cousin J after getting dumped

i know u been thru some shit in ur life. i ain't gonna question that. so in exchange? what u can do is respect the fact that i don't like the idea of getting turned into one of ur little empty war toys
Thanks for asking so nicely, asshole.
I didn't like being accused of wanting to turn you into one.
I know. And I reacted poorly. And I'm sorry.
.... ok yeah that was outta line on my part, cuz. i was pranging out. not proud of it. forgiven
that explains y ur still here w/ us fkers in a warzone
i'm just sittin' here wondering why u don't go home. y'know. back 2 where u came from, instead of being stuck here w/ us fkers in a warzone
LMAO!!! hahaha yeah yeah i deserve that sry, sry
while ur here, curious about something. u got a home or what? ur crashing here like ur my cousin J after getting dumped
u srsly that hard up for friends? u said u didn't have any1 waiting 4 u
u srsly that lonely? lol u gotta have people waiting 4 u wherever ur from in the future
unless u r srsly that hard up for a place, u said u didn't have any1 waiting 4 u, u rly have nowhere?
No. I really don't have anyone.
Are you going to start laughing at me, Quincy?
Are you going to start laughing at me, Quincy?
I make my home wherever I am.
didn't u save everybody? from the cult or w/e?
nah. nah i'm not. bc if that's true? that is... mad peak...
respect that. but u here with us 'n we just met, which says 2 me u got nowhere that... matters 2 u. mad peak
Yeah. I did. And they sent me back here, didn't they?
I... don't want to get into this, Quincy. [End.]
what about that weird place ur from? duvir-w/e
wound u up, marched u forward, n left u wherever u fell. do u think they even care if u go back?
Did you miss the part about the constant murder and imaginary people?
n that ship? what about that? u said that was close 2 being a home
I escaped a personal hell only to wind up in a dimension where the system was overtaken by a madman bent on total domination. "Home."
The only place I've ever really known as home is a derelict ship trapped like a cork in a rift in dimensions, inhabited by ghosts and terrible memories.
I was trapped for untold centuries in an infinitely looping dimension where I was subject to torture and murder at the hands of a child despot.
I'm sure they do. But it's not the same. I've never felt like I belong.
They do. But they care about the kid, more. And I get it. That isn't my reality. It's fine.
just cuz i read it doesn't mean i can wrap my head around it, cuz. fking mental is what that is
Key word there is "close." it's also haunted with ghosts and where the Man in the Wall made us...
i been that toy soldier b4. been told i was the best. 'the CHAMPION' gonna go save the WORLD from BADDIES. fed all the lies
maybe. maybe not. or maybe ur just useful to them until ur not. careful, cuz. been there. done that
ur gunna need to talk me thru it next time. but i guess if thats what u had to choose from? there or here?
... made u what? ho shit, what did that thing do 2 u? u got beef with a GOD?! fking hell
I had to fight, largely on my own, to free the Origin System's brainwashed innocents to try to rise up and fight the two lunatics in charge of it.
That was the first place I met the Indifference. It wouldn't be the last. But that was where the Man in the Wall took *everything* from me.
Who, by the way, was a creation of my own memories when the Void reached into my mind and pulled out fragments of a storybook.
but when it came down 2 it? when i needed THEM? when i got hurt or needed help? naaaaah fam
free advice. u always find out 2 late who ur real fam is. so keep ur eyes open
at least this shithole has my lux ass classing up the joint lmao
n those people u saved didn't roll out the red carpet 4 u? do u think they care if u go back?
ho shit, what did that thing do 2 u? u got beef with a GOD?! fking hell
suddenly i'm just a fking number. just time 2 go 2 some office in a hole 2 get told 2 fk off
'n at least u pick up after urself. fk. somebody teach amir where trash goes. dutty boy gonna attract more pets for lettie
I think that's you saying I'm welcome here?
Somebody has to stick around to keep you humble.
u n me got some shit in common, huh. just not the good shit
HAH. u gonna give up on that real fast, cuz. but u give it a go, i'll love watching u try
gj u figured it out. lol. yeah, i'm saying u could be worse company
not gonna spell it out 4 u, muppet. lol. think real hard u'll get there
